reads_as_reason: The surface is smooth, but the thigh and shank are beaded with several bulges and pinches, so they read as a sculpted bone or sausage-link form rather than one tapering shell.

G1.evidence: No chibi proportion or box block; flat rounded-rectangle sections suit an adult product. The wavy outline (thigh narrows mid-length then swells above the knee; shank bulges at the calf then pinches above the ankle) looks organic and cartoon-like.

G2.evidence: Front and 3/4 views: hourglass pinch about 40% down the thigh, knee end swells back out; shank repeats with a calf lump and ankle waist. 4 to 5 alternating bumps, not a flowing taper. The knee is a hairline gap with no deliberate recess; the shank's diagonal cut face is a bare flat plane. Agrees with failed P8a (0.788) and P8b (0.807).

G3.evidence: Single-tone clay; dark recess colour not rendered. Geometry offers no clear recess band at the knee to carry a dark tone.

G4.evidence: Thigh and shank share the same rounded-rectangle section family and similar corner radii; zebra shows continuous nested contour bands with no creases (S4a 0.2179), unlike the baseline's patchy zebra.

G6.evidence: No references supplied. Matches Optimus/Atlas on flat-sided section and large radii; does not match on the mid-thigh pinch, lumpy calf, and missing distinct knee joint.

pairwise.evidence: Moderate preference. The baseline thigh is a straight, nearly untapered slab sitting on a knee ball, with a chaotic blotchy zebra on thigh and shank; it reads as a toy exclamation mark. The candidate has more deliberate form and a cleaner, continuous surface; its weakness is that the wobble looks undesigned. Neither is a finished product.

top_changes.change: Remove the mid-thigh hourglass; make width and depth fall monotonically hip to knee.
Merge calf bulge and ankle waist into one smooth taper.
Make the knee a deliberate joint: a waist at the joint so the gap reads as a dark recess band, not a hairline seam.

notes: G3 not judgeable; no references, so G6 UNCERTAIN. Only the candidate's metrics were available.
